module purpose: neorv32_neoled stores control settings (enable, word mode, strobe, time-base select, interrupt configuration, bit timing) written over its bus interface, pushes tagged data words into a TX buffer sub-unit (data_buffer), and runs a serial engine that pops each word and encodes its bits as timed high/low pulses on neoled_o; it also drives clkgen_en_o from the enable, raises irq_o from the buffer level, and returns settings and status on a bus read.

use-case flows.value: control word from the bus write data stored into the enable, mode, strobe, prescaler-select, interrupt-configuration and bit-timing settings on a write with addr(2) = '0'; the enable is exported on clkgen_en_o
data word, tagged with the current strobe and mode settings, pushed into the TX buffer on a write with addr(2) = '1'

word fetch and decode: buffer read request in the enabled idle state, shift-register load, word width (24 or 32 bits) and data-versus-strobe branch chosen from the word's tag bits when the buffer holds a word

bit serialization: current bit selected by the word mode, its high time chosen from t0_high or t1_high, pulse counter advanced on the selected time-base tick and compared with the high time and the total bit period, neoled_o driven high then low, bit counter decremented until the word ends
strobe interval: neoled_o held low while the strobe counter counts whole bit periods until all its bits are set
interrupt request: while enabled, buffer empty (irq_conf = '0') or buffer below half (irq_conf = '1'), registered on irq_o
status bits (buffer empty, half, full, engine busy) returned on a bus read
stored settings and the buffer size returned on a bus read
settings, bus response, interrupt, serial engine registers and neoled_o forced to zero while rstn_i = '0'; a cleared enable also clears the buffer and keeps the engine out of its active states
